quests.hint: Possessing a thesis that is unfalsifiable by its very construction.
quests.explanation: Describes a claim structured so that no possible evidence could ever disprove it.
quests.meaning: A claim structured so that no possible evidence could ever disprove it.
quests.sampleUsage: Critics noted her thesis was unfalsifiable by its very construction.

quests.hint: A particular distinction that dissolves under sufficiently close examination.
quests.explanation: Describes a seemingly clear difference that breaks down when scrutinised carefully.
quests.meaning: A seemingly clear difference between two concepts that breaks down under close scrutiny.
quests.sampleUsage: The distinction dissolved entirely under sufficiently close examination.

quests.hint: Possessing an argument whose force depends on an unstated value judgement.
quests.explanation: Describes reasoning that only persuades if you already share its hidden moral premise.
quests.meaning: Reasoning that only persuades if the listener already shares its hidden moral premise.
quests.sampleUsage: The argument's force depended on an unstated value judgement few shared.
quests.correctAnswer: Depend on an unstated value judgement
quests.expression: Depend on an unstated value judgement
quests.textToSpeak: Depend on an unstated value judgement

quests.hint: A particular theory that explains everything and therefore nothing.
quests.explanation: Describes a framework so flexible it can account for any outcome, making it untestable.
quests.meaning: A framework so flexible it can account for any outcome, rendering it untestable.
quests.sampleUsage: Critics dismissed it as a theory that explains everything and therefore nothing.

quests.hint: Possessing the rigour to identify where an analogy breaks down.
quests.explanation: Describes recognising the precise point at which a comparison stops being useful.
quests.meaning: Recognising the precise point at which a useful comparison stops holding true.
quests.sampleUsage: She identified exactly where the analogy began to break down.
quests.correctAnswer: Identify where an analogy breaks down
quests.expression: Identify where an analogy breaks down
quests.textToSpeak: Identify where an analogy breaks down

quests.hint: A particular claim defensible only by retreating to an unfalsifiable core.
quests.explanation: Describes a position that, when challenged, narrows itself until it cannot be tested.
quests.meaning: A position that, when challenged, narrows itself until it can no longer be tested.
quests.sampleUsage: Every challenge made him retreat further into an unfalsifiable core.

quests.hint: Possessing the discernment to separate a strawman from a fair representation.
quests.explanation: Describes recognising when an opposing view has been misrepresented as weaker than it is.
quests.meaning: Recognising when an opposing view has been misrepresented as weaker than it actually is.
quests.sampleUsage: She called out the strawman, insisting on a fair representation.
quests.correctAnswer: A strawman, not a fair representation
quests.expression: A strawman, not a fair representation
quests.textToSpeak: A strawman, not a fair representation

quests.hint: A particular result that holds in expectation but not in any single instance.
quests.explanation: Describes a statistical truth valid on average across many cases, though unreliable for one case.
quests.meaning: A statistical truth valid on average across many cases, though unreliable for any single one.
quests.sampleUsage: The result held in expectation, even though no single trial matched it.
quests.correctAnswer: Hold in expectation, not in instance
quests.expression: Hold in expectation, not in instance
quests.textToSpeak: Hold in expectation, not in instance

quests.hint: Possessing the rigour to avoid mistaking absence of evidence for evidence of absence.
quests.explanation: Describes recognising that not finding proof of something is not proof it doesn't exist.
quests.meaning: Recognising that failing to find proof of something is not proof that it doesn't exist.
quests.sampleUsage: She was careful not to mistake absence of evidence for evidence of absence.
quests.correctAnswer: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence
quests.expression: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence
quests.textToSpeak: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence

quests.hint: A particular framework whose internal logic outpaces its external validity.
quests.explanation: Describes a theory that is logically tight but poorly tested against real-world data.
quests.meaning: A theory that is internally logically consistent but poorly tested against real-world data.
quests.sampleUsage: Their framework's internal logic outpaced its actual external validity.

quests.hint: Possessing the discipline to treat a model as a map, not the territory.
quests.explanation: Describes recognising that a simplified representation is never the full reality it describes.
quests.meaning: Recognising that a simplified representation is never identical to the full reality it describes.
quests.sampleUsage: She always remembered the model was a map, not the territory itself.
quests.correctAnswer: The map is not the territory
quests.expression: The map is not the territory
quests.textToSpeak: The map is not the territory

quests.hint: A particular claim whose certainty exceeds what the evidence can bear.
quests.explanation: Describes confidence expressed beyond what the available proof actually justifies.
quests.meaning: Confidence expressed in a claim well beyond what the available proof actually justifies.
quests.sampleUsage: His certainty far exceeded what the thin evidence could bear.

quests.hint: Possessing the rigour to bound a claim's domain of applicability.
quests.explanation: Describes specifying clearly the conditions under which an assertion is actually valid.
quests.meaning: Specifying clearly the precise conditions under which an assertion is actually valid.
quests.sampleUsage: She bounded the claim's domain of applicability before generalising further.

quests.hint: A particular argument that wins on rhetoric while losing on substance.
quests.explanation: Describes a position that persuades through style despite being weak in actual content.
quests.meaning: A position that persuades through rhetorical style despite being weak in actual substance.
quests.sampleUsage: The speech won on rhetoric, even though it lost badly on substance.
quests.correctAnswer: Win on rhetoric, lose on substance
quests.expression: Win on rhetoric, lose on substance
quests.textToSpeak: Win on rhetoric, lose on substance

quests.hint: Possessing the discernment to recognise an argument from authority's limits.
quests.explanation: Describes understanding that an expert's opinion does not automatically guarantee correctness.
quests.meaning: Understanding that an expert's opinion does not automatically guarantee that it is correct.
quests.sampleUsage: She recognised the limits of an argument from authority, however credentialed.

quests.hint: A particular position that survives only by shifting its own goalposts.
quests.explanation: Describes a stance that avoids refutation by quietly redefining what would count as proof.
quests.meaning: A stance that avoids refutation by quietly redefining what would count as disproof.
quests.sampleUsage: Every time he was challenged, he simply moved the goalposts.

quests.hint: Possessing the rigour to distinguish a model's fit from its truth.
quests.explanation: Describes recognising that a theory matching the data well isn't necessarily a correct theory.
quests.meaning: Recognising that a theory matching observed data well is not necessarily a true theory.
quests.sampleUsage: She distinguished the model's statistical fit from its actual truth.

quests.hint: A particular claim whose persuasiveness depends on its audience's prior beliefs.
quests.explanation: Describes an argument that lands only with people already inclined to accept its conclusion.
quests.meaning: An argument that persuades effectively only with audiences already inclined to accept its conclusion.
quests.sampleUsage: Its persuasiveness depended entirely on the audience's prior beliefs.
quests.correctAnswer: Persuasive only to the already convinced
quests.expression: Persuasive only to the already convinced
quests.textToSpeak: Persuasive only to the already convinced

quests.hint: Possessing the discipline to evaluate a theory on predictive, not narrative, success.
quests.explanation: Describes judging an idea by its forecasting accuracy rather than how compelling its story sounds.
quests.meaning: Judging an idea by its forecasting accuracy rather than how compelling its narrative sounds.
quests.sampleUsage: She judged the theory on predictive success, not narrative appeal.

quests.hint: A particular distinction that matters in theory but rarely in practice.
quests.explanation: Describes a conceptual difference with little practical consequence in real-world application.
quests.meaning: A conceptual difference that carries little practical consequence in real-world application.
quests.sampleUsage: The distinction mattered in theory but rarely showed up in practice.
quests.correctAnswer: Matter in theory, not in practice
quests.expression: Matter in theory, not in practice
quests.textToSpeak: Matter in theory, not in practice

quests.hint: Possessing the rigour to recognise when a sample fails to represent its population.
quests.explanation: Describes identifying when the data examined doesn't reflect the broader group it claims to.
quests.meaning: Identifying when the data examined does not accurately reflect the broader group it claims to represent.
quests.sampleUsage: The sample failed to represent the wider population fairly.
quests.correctAnswer: A sample that fails to represent the population
quests.expression: A sample that fails to represent the population
quests.textToSpeak: A sample that fails to represent the population

quests.hint: A particular claim that is technically correct yet practically meaningless.
quests.explanation: Describes an assertion accurate in a narrow sense but useless for any real decision.
quests.meaning: An assertion that is accurate in a narrow technical sense but useless for any real decision.
quests.sampleUsage: His claim was technically correct, yet practically meaningless.

quests.hint: Possessing the discernment to separate robustness from mere replication.
quests.explanation: Describes recognising that repeating a result isn't the same as proving it holds broadly.
quests.meaning: Recognising that repeating a result is not the same as proving it holds under broader conditions.
quests.sampleUsage: She separated genuine robustness from simple, narrow replication.

quests.hint: A particular thesis that gains apparent strength only through vagueness.
quests.explanation: Describes an argument that seems convincing mainly because it avoids being specific.
quests.meaning: An argument that seems convincing mainly because it deliberately avoids being specific.
quests.sampleUsage: Its apparent strength came only from carefully maintained vagueness.

quests.hint: Possessing the rigour to hold a conclusion as provisional, not final.
quests.explanation: Describes treating a result as the current best understanding, open to future revision.
quests.meaning: Treating a result as the current best understanding, while remaining open to future revision.
quests.sampleUsage: She held the conclusion as provisional, ready to revise it later.

quests.hint: A particular insight that survives translation across radically different fields.
quests.explanation: Describes an idea robust enough to remain meaningful when applied outside its original domain.
quests.meaning: An idea robust enough to remain genuinely meaningful when applied outside its original domain.
quests.sampleUsage: The insight survived translation into a completely unrelated field.

quests.hint: Possessing the discipline to let evidence outrank intuition, however compelling.
quests.explanation: Describes prioritising data over gut feeling, no matter how persuasive that feeling is.
quests.meaning: Prioritising rigorous evidence over gut feeling, no matter how persuasive that feeling seems.
quests.sampleUsage: She let the evidence outrank her own compelling intuition.

quests.hint: A particular synthesis that resolves a tension others had merely described.
quests.explanation: Describes an insight that genuinely reconciles a contradiction rather than just naming it.
quests.meaning: An insight that genuinely reconciles a long-standing contradiction rather than merely describing it.
quests.sampleUsage: Her synthesis finally resolved a tension others had only described.

quests.hint: Possessing a conclusion earned through the full weight of accumulated evidence.
quests.explanation: Describes a final position justified only after exhaustive, careful consideration of all proof.
quests.meaning: A final position justified only after exhaustive and careful consideration of all available proof.
quests.sampleUsage: Her conclusion was earned through the full weight of accumulated evidence.

quests.hint: A particular mastery shown by knowing precisely when a rule does not apply.
quests.explanation: Describes true expertise demonstrated by recognising the limits of one's own principles.
quests.meaning: True expertise demonstrated by recognising the precise limits of one's own guiding principles.
quests.sampleUsage: Her mastery was clearest in knowing exactly when the rule didn't apply.
quests.correctAnswer: Know when the rule does not apply
quests.expression: Know when the rule does not apply
quests.textToSpeak: Know when the rule does not apply
